in_hebrew.name: בראס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Baras is derived from the Hebrew word ‘baras’, which means ‘lightning’ or ‘thunder’. In the Bible, the name Baras is not found. However, the name may be related to the Hebrew names Baruch (Blessed) or Barqoh (Lightning).

in_greek.name: Βάρας
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Baras is not found in Greek scripture. However, it may be derived from the Greek name Ααρών (Aaron), which means ‘mountain of strength’. In Christian tradition, St. Baras is venerated as a martyr and is believed to have lived in Syria during the early Christian era.

in_latin.name: BARAS
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Baras in Latin is derived from the Greek name Βάρας (Báras), which means ‘Son of Aaron’. In Christian tradition, St. Baras is venerated as a martyr and is believed to have lived in Syria during the early Christian era.
